Enter batch costs once. Labor hours should cover all preparation and expected fulfillment; do not also include that labor in cleaning or operating costs. Operating cost allocation is a batch total, not a monthly total.

Prices are before customer sales tax. Cash ignores fee and shipping fields; card uses your fee fields and assumes one item per transaction, excluding buyer-tax processing. Marketplace mode uses a flat custom fee on item price plus charged shipping; enter account/category rates. Tiered fees, fees on buyer tax, and promotions are not modeled here.

Premium items are part of expected sold items. Enter their combined proceeds after platform/payment fees, shipping and packaging, before the batch acquisition and preparation costs above. Remaining-item fees apply only to the remaining items.

Fee settings
How it works

Bulk purchase / pallet

Enter whole-batch purchase, preparation and operating costs, expected sales and desired profit. Optional premium proceeds lower the average needed from the remaining items. Results are average prices, not market-value estimates. Custom channel fees are simplified.

Storefront

Choose RetroReplay Storefront in the platform menu. Individual item and fill-a-bag scenarios compare cash and card contribution before monthly overhead, with tax added or included, rounded suggestions, markdowns and overhead coverage.

Should I buy?

Enter an expected list price based on sold comps. Maximum buy price is a ceiling, not an assumed purchase cost. Enter the actual cost to see expected profit.

Price my item

Enter actual cost, including zero for a free item. The minimum sale price covers expenses and target profit. Suggested list price leaves room for offers.

Expenses

Defaults include $1 supplies and 20 minutes at $18/hour ($6 labor). Adjust these to your workflow. Do not add an all-in cost allowance on top of expenses already included. Liquidation can use a zero profit or seller-net target.

Estimates

Buyer taxes are estimated and only used in supported fee bases. Category, account and special-service fees can differ. Promotion is not included. Fee settings for platforms without a checked source remain unverified presets.
